issues.description: CLI transform doesn't handle empty string from bare --coverage.changed flag
issues.detail: In cli-config.ts, the transform only maps 'true'/'false'/'yes'/'no' to booleans. If a user passes `--coverage.changed` without a value, cac typically yields true or an empty string depending on parsing; the empty string case is not normalized and would be passed downstream as a falsy non-boolean to git ref resolution.

issues.description: changedFiles from VitestGit may be relative paths but compared to slashed absolute filenames
issues.detail: In onTestRunStart, findChangedFiles returns paths that may be repo-relative or absolute git output, while isIncluded passes slash(cleanUrl(_filename)) which is typically absolute. The membership check `this.changedFiles.includes(filename)` will silently exclude all files if formats don't match, producing empty coverage with no error.

issues.description: globCache cleared in onTestRunStart but populated again with changedFiles-dependent results
issues.detail: The cache key is just the filename, but the cached `included` value now depends on changedFiles state. If onTestRunStart is called multiple times (e.g., watch mode reruns) with a different changed ref, only the initial clear protects correctness; any caching between resolution and start risks stale entries. Consider invalidating whenever changedFiles changes.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook added to three call sites but not to collect/typecheck paths
issues.detail: core.ts adds `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` after three _testRun.start calls, but other entry points like collectFiles or typechecker runs may also invoke coverage generation. If any path generates coverage without first calling onTestRunStart, `changedFiles` will be undefined and coverage will incorrectly include all files.

issues.description: Docs claim `true` uses staged/unstaged changes but implementation passes to git as ref
issues.detail: The docs say setting `changed: true` uses staged and unstaged changes, but in onTestRunStart `this.options.changed` truthy triggers `findChangedFiles({ changedSince: true })`. Verify VitestGit interprets a boolean true value the way the docs describe; otherwise the documented behavior diverges from the implementation.

The diff shows `old mode 100644 / new mode 100755` on test/coverage-test/test/changed.test.ts. Test files should not be executable; this looks like an accidental chmod change and adds noise to the diff with no benefit.

review.summary: The feature is well-scoped and the test coverage is solid, including good combinations of `changed` and `coverage.changed`. Main concerns are around defensive correctness: the CLI transform doesn't handle empty-string from bare flags, the changedFiles array's path format is not normalized against the slashed/cleaned filenames used in isIncluded, and the new onTestRunStart hook is wired only into three of potentially more coverage-generating call sites. A minor docs/behavior mismatch around `changed: true` and an inadvertent file-mode change to 0755 round out the findings.
